purpose: Reproduce the supplementary bounded negative search on the Coordinated239 branch; this is not part of the acceptance proof of M238.

inputs.conversion: For each ordered JSON triple [pc,op,arg], emit pc, op, arg separated by single spaces; use 0 for the null operand of CH; append newline. No instruction path, order, or operative operand changes.

recorded_execution: The recorded logs and receipt are from this task's completed new run on the final Coordinated239 table. The search was not rerun during packaging.
license_and_attribution: Inherited code and algorithm notices remain applicable; see the package licenses and attribution. The original profile and finite-window search sources are copied byte-for-byte. This task contributes the new run, its input profile, receipt, and explicit bounded scope.
